product.title: You-Drive 4x4 UTV Adventure–Hell's Revenge & Fins N' Things, Moab

description.text: Take an adventurous ride into the sunset on a UTV (similar to an ATV) on the Hell's Revenge Trail. You'll pass petrified sand dunes and get the chance to take in great views of the surrounding canyons and rock formations as you zip over rough and slick terrains. Stops include Hells Revenge Safari Route. Best of all, you'll get to experience the thrill of driving yourself.Reservation is for one UTV, a single reservation is not a multiple vehicle reservation. Ideal for travelers basing in Moab who want a guided Utah adventure without self-driving backcountry roads or river put-ins.
